recipe.visualDefinition: A muted, desaturated 1970s urban street photograph framed within a large rounded rectangle, set against a solid taupe background with two distinct levels of typography positioned at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The central photograph is nested within a thick, solid-colored border that acts as a canvas for the text.
The primary display text at the top uses a heavy, outlined slab serif, while the secondary text uses a thin, gestural hand-drawn style.
The color of the outer frame matches the mid-tones of the urban shadows in the photograph, creating a unified palette.
coreInvariants: Rounded corners on the central image frame
Muted, slightly warm color cast in the photography
Strict vertical stacking of text elements above the image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A candid street scene occupies the lower two-thirds of the composition, framed by a rounded rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the white t-shirt walking toward the viewer serves as the focal point within the photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold white text at the top, moves down to the expressive script, and settles into the depth of the street scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample solid taupe space at the top and bottom margins provides breathing room for the typography.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep Blue and Earthy Reds (Found within the street photography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across the entire piece, giving it a vintage, film-like quality.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy Slab Serif and Expressive Script
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Extra-bold, condensed slab serif with a thin white outline and dark fill.
Secondary text: Irregular, hand-drawn ink script with varying line weights and long horizontal dashes on either side.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' and 'E' in the primary text have distinct, sharp slab serifs.
The script text features 'drip' or 'ink-bleed' effects on the terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a rigid, industrial slab serif and a fluid, organic hand-drawn script.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangle frame with a thin inner stroke

avoid: Sharp 90-degree corners on the image frame

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Stymie Black or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure of the primary text.
Captures the raw, hand-drawn feel of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A desaturated 1970s street photograph of a crowd walking on a city sidewalk, framed within a large rounded rectangle on a solid taupe background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, outlined slab serif text at the top center. Below it, add a hand-drawn, ink-style script flanked by long horizontal dashes.

verificationChecks: Is the background color a consistent muted taupe?
Does the top text have a visible white outline?
Is the script text appropriately irregular and organic?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the image frame
Density of the crowd in the photograph
mustRedesign: Any recognizable brand logos on the street

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color palette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is centered and legible.
Check that the rounded corners of the frame are symmetrical.
Verify the desaturated, warm color cast of the photograph.
Confirm the presence of the horizontal dashes in the subtitle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Muted background + Rounded frame photo + Heavy slab serif + Organic script = 70s Singer-Songwriter Aesthetic.
